# opnsense_auth_user_api_key (Resource)

API key of a user (**System ▸ Access ▸ Users ▸ API keys**). OPNsense returns the secret only when the key is created: it is stored in the state, so keep the state protected, and it is unknown after an import. Destroying the resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_auth_user" "automation" {
  name               = "automation"
  scrambled_password = true
}

resource "opnsense_auth_user_api_key" "automation" {
  username = opnsense_auth_user.automation.name
}

output "api_key" {
  value = opnsense_auth_user_api_key.automation.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Name of the user the key belongs to, e.g. `opnsense_auth_user.automation.name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `key`.
- `key` (String) API key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) API secret, only known when the key is created by this resource.
